verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page lists 'Full accounts payable' as its own service, which bears directly on vendor bills and AP. Nothing describes how bills are captured, routed for approval or scheduled for payment, and nothing shows these happen in a single workflow. The Bill.com integration is a third-party tool and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented bill capture, approval routing, payment scheduling, a unified single-workflow experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AP service.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow
